scenario_B_gate_matters.question: Incremental: does GATE cell add fit beyond pct_rv cell? (not relative ranking of GATE vs pct_rv alone)
scenario_B_gate_matters.method: nested OLS partial-F + LR; H0: gate coefs = 0 | pct_rv

interpretation.INCREMENTAL_YES: GATE aporta fit más allá de pct_rv (p<0.05 y ΔR²>0.01)
interpretation.INCREMENTAL_WEAK: Significativo pero ΔR² pequeño — cautela práctica
interpretation.INCREMENTAL_NO: No se rechaza H0: coefs GATE = 0 | pct_rv

literature.H0_no_improvement: equivalent to coef(Y|X)=0 in risk model (Pepe et al.)
